changelog:
- Initial release of sher-deploy.
- Instantly build and deploy frontend projects to live preview URLs.
- Auto-detects popular frontend frameworks and build outputs.
- Supports deployment options: custom output directory, link expiry, build skipping, and password protection (Pro).
- CLI returns the preview URL via stdout; works headlessly and without an account (limited features).
- Provides troubleshooting steps and agent-friendly defaults.
summary: Build and deploy frontend projects to instant preview URLs. Auto-detects frameworks.
